subject.title: Feature: config-level default task notify policy

question: What public default task notify policy surface should OpenClaw support for ACP, subagent, and Task Flow records: one global default, a per-runtime map, or no new config until related channel and announce-policy work is settled?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding config/default behavior is compatibility-sensitive and overlaps active Discord, Codex visibility, ACP flood-control, and subagent announce-suppression decisions.

options.title: Adopt a per-runtime default map
options.body: Add an additive config shape that defaults to current behavior while allowing targeted ACP/subagent/flow overrides without changing cron, CLI, or media semantics.

options.title: Adopt one global task default
options.body: Expose a simpler config key but require explicit exceptions for currently quiet task classes to avoid surprise message-volume changes.

options.title: Defer until policy work converges
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers settle the related channel visibility and announce-routing surfaces before adding another public config key.

recommendation.title: Adopt a per-runtime default map
recommendation.body: Add an additive config shape that defaults to current behavior while allowing targeted ACP/subagent/flow overrides without changing cron, CLI, or media semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest cross-cutting history signal across config defaults, agent runtime, subagent behavior, and public API direction.
